51221716.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human polyhisitdine-tagged/puritin-fused IRE1 by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface Plasmon: Surface Plasmon Resonance. Surface plasmon resonance measurement was performed using a Biacore T200 system (GE Healthcare). A total of 9700 resonance units of human IRE-1 (59.2 kDa polyhistidine-tagged puritin–hIRE-1 fusion protein) was immobilized through amine coupling (EDC/NHS) in the flow cell of a CMS sensor chip at a speed of 5 μL/min, and a control well was similarly treated with buffer only (PBS, pH 7.4, containing 2% DMSO). Inhibitors of various concentrations were injected at a speed of 40 μL/min in PBS, pH 7.4, containing 2% DMSO. Chip surface was regenerated by injecting 10 μL solution of 50 mM aq NaOH at a speed of 5 μL/min. Resonance differences between the wells containing proteins, and the control wells were plotted against inhibitor concentrations. Determination of Kd was performed through asymptotic 1 fitting of the curve to steady-state one site binding model (OriginPro 8.5).
original_paragraph.Figure 1 caption: Figure 1. Development of potent tricyclic chromenone inhibitors of IRE-1 by installation of different amine substituents and protective moieties; IRE-1 inhibitors with 1,3-dioxane acetal protective groups emit strong fluorescence. (A) Chemical structures of 1, 2, and 3 with different amine substituent groups (R1). (B) IRE-1 binding affinities of 2 and 3 as determined by surface plasmon resonance. (C) STGM1 cells were treated with 1, 2, and 3 at 10 μM for 0, 3, 6, 12, or 24 h, lysed, and analyzed for indicated proteins by immunoblots. (D) Chemical structures of derivatives of 2 and 3 carrying different protective groups (R2). (E) Fluorescence intensities of 2 and 3 derivatives with different protective groups in aqueous solution (10 μM, DMSO/PBS mixture (v/v = 1:99), Ex = 360 nm). (F) The enlarged fluorescence spectra of 2, 3, 6, 8, and 9 in aqueous solution (10 μM, DMSO/PBS mixture (v/v = 1:99), Ex = 360 nm). (G) Fluorescence images of 2 and 3 derivatives with different protective groups in aqueous solution (10 μM, DMSO/PBS mixture (v/v = 1:99)) under illumination at 365 nm.

immobilization.ligand_name: human IRE-1 (59.2 kDa polyhistidine-tagged puritin–hIRE-1 fusion protein)

data_analysis.reference_description: Control well treated with buffer only (PBS, pH 7.4, containing 2% DMSO)
